st09-16.draft: Mofuta oa lehodimo o etsang hore o leboge lintho tsa mahala.

st09-17.en: Sky's grumbling. Stay close to a roof.
st09-17.draft: Lehodimo le a duma. Lula haufi le marulelo.

st09-18.en: The ozone layer called. It's on leave.
st09-18.draft: Ozone layer e llelitse. E leaveng.

st09-20.draft: Setofo sa letsatsi ha se kgetho, boet.

st09-21.en: The puddle was deeper than it looked. It's always deeper.
st09-21.draft: Letamo le ne le tebile ho feta kamoo le neng le shebahala kateng. Le lula le tebile.

st09-22.en: This is the stuff. Right here.

st09-23.en: Probably fog later. The Boland does this.
st09-23.draft: Mohlomong mohodi hamorao. Boland e etsa sena.

st10-01.en: The sky is the colour of an old Tupperware lid.
st10-01.draft: Lehodimo le na le 'mala oa sekoahelo sa Tupperware sa khale.

st10-02.en: Your car seat is a weapon right now.
st10-02.draft: Setulo sa koloi ea hao ke sebetsa joale.

st10-03.en: Take a brolly just in case, hey.
st10-03.draft: Nka sekhele ho ba sireletsehile, hey.

st10-04.en: 50/50 on getting wet. Like a coin toss.
st10-04.draft: 50/50 ho ba metsi. Joalo ka papadi.

st10-05.en: This is the weather we brag about overseas.
st10-05.draft: Lena ke leholimo leo re le iponelang lichaba.

st10-06.en: Cloud's the call. With an asterisk.

st10-07.en: Even the Capetonians are admitting it's cold.
st10-07.draft: Esita le ba Cape ba lumela hore ho a bata.

st10-08.en: Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: the koue belt is doing its koue thing.
st10-08.draft: Welkom, Sasolburg, Kroonstad: koue belt e etsa koue thing ya yona.

st10-09.draft: Lehodimo la Afrika le fapane feela.

st10-10.en: The sun is technically present. Spiritually elsewhere.
st10-10.draft: Letsatsi ka tsela ea ts'ebetso le teng. Ka moea le sebakeng se seng.

st10-11.en: Don't touch the seatbelt buckle. Trust us.
st10-11.draft: Se ke oa ama buckle ea seatbelt. Re tšepe.

st10-12.draft: Slip-slops, libhulukoe tse khutšoanyane, letsatsi. Boraro bo bong.

st10-13.en: Even the bakkies on the N2 pulled over.
st10-13.draft: Esita le li-bakkie tsa N2 li emile ka thoko.

st10-14.en: Protect that face! It's the only one you've got.
st10-14.draft: Sireletsa sefahleho seo! Ke se le seng feela o nang le sona.

st10-15.en: Cloud's around. How much is up for debate.
st10-15.draft: Maru a potolohile. Hore na a makae ke ngangisano.

st10-16.en: The sky's giving 'I'll try again tomorrow' energy.
st10-16.draft: Lehodimo le fana le 'ke tla leka hosane' matla.

st10-17.en: The geyser tripped overnight. Of course it did.
st10-17.draft: Geyser e tripile bosiu. Of course e entse jwalo.

st10-18.en: Garage pie for lunch because the kitchen is lava.
st10-18.draft: Paee ea garage hobane kitchen ke lava.

st10-19.en: Coffee count: rising. Motivation count: still zero.
st10-19.draft: Palo ea kofi: e nyolohang. Palo ea khothatso: e ntse e le zero.

st10-20.draft: Esita le GPS ea hao e ferekane.

st10-21.en: Your nose is going to betray you by 3pm.
st10-21.draft: Nko ea hao e tla o eka ka 3pm.

st10-22.en: The sun's on a tea break. No ETA.
st10-22.draft: Letsatsi le phomoletseng ho noa tee. Ha ho ETA.

st10-23.en: The vibe is beige. Accept it.
